suite.name: CB Suite
suite.notes: An app download that stalls now stops after a minute and says so instead of hanging, and a full disk is reported properly.

dashboard.name: CB Dashboard
dashboard.notes: New in Settings → Displays → This computer: Open at sign-in, so the TVs come back on their own after a restart, and Keep screens awake, so Windows doesn't turn them off. A TV whose page crashes now reloads itself. Fixes: a page you switch away from no longer keeps checking Aspire in the background, and an Aspire sign-in that stops working is renewed straight away instead of failing until the next day.

requests.name: Equipment Requests - Aspire
requests.notes: Helps stop two tickets being made for the same request. If the repair card doesn't attach at first, the app now tries again before giving up. And if a ticket with no notes or repair card was made on the Equipment Repairs route in the last day, the app stops before making another and asks you to check Aspire, in case that ticket is already for this request. If it isn't, click Create anyway.

photos.name: Property Photos - Aspire
photos.notes: Map pieces are now deleted 30 days after they're downloaded, so the app's storage can't keep growing. An Aspire sign-in that stops working is renewed straight away, a stuck photo download gives up after two minutes and tries again, and one photo with no date can no longer stop a property from loading.
